title: Design System: OnDesk products

scope.applies: The six product SPAs (pulse, vault, orbit, nexus, halo, atlas) wherever .site reaches, which is the whole document because each app mounts class="site" on <html> (index.html) and imports @ondesk/shared/styles/site.css then product.css from src/index.css. The shell is each app's src/shell/workspace-shell.tsx (one template; Pulse read here) composed from shared/components/product-shell.tsx; pages use shared/components/console.tsx and console-kit.tsx; the map pieces are shared/components/map.tsx and shared/lib/lines.ts; the 24 shadcn primitives under shared/ui/ are rewritten as map components with their API kept; presence is shared/presence/status.ts and presence-dot.tsx; shared/components/theme-provider.tsx is a light-only shim. Halo's in-call room and Atlas's capture HUD keep their own chrome. The direction contract is pulse/.impeccable/surfaces/pulse-src-shell-workspace-shell-tsx.md and is not copied into shipped code.
scope.extends: ondesk/DESIGN.md (The Network Map); this file records what the products add or change and inherits everything else.

crossRepoCopies.siteCss: shared/styles/site.css must stay byte-identical to ondesk/src/site.css (md5 aa12f9a6422fbf4721fd96761b7d8b56 on both, verified 2026-09-30). The four consoles' copies (ondesk, partners, developers, admin) are meant to match too; on 2026-09-30 partners = developers != ondesk and admin != ondesk (recorded in notCanonized).
crossRepoCopies.sharedVersion: package.json version 1.6.0; newest git tag v1.4.0; 1.6.0 untagged as of 2026-09-30.
crossRepoCopies.designMdCopies: shared/DESIGN.md and shared/.impeccable/design.json are canonical; identical copies live at pulse/, vault/, orbit/, nexus/, halo/ and atlas/ (DESIGN.md + .impeccable/design.json), as the four consoles keep their own copy.

share-grey.purpose: The third step of the chart share ramp and --chart-5 (product.css); appears nowhere else.

display.purpose: The plate H1 of the workspace picker and the root 404, 2.2rem to 2.8rem, inside .plate-lines.

figure.purpose: A StatTile value in the zone table: t-display t-num at 2rem, 2.5rem from 768px.

headline.purpose: PageHeader and Section titles, 1.5rem to 1.625rem, the page's first Stop.

title.purpose: Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet and SheetDialog titles at 1.25rem; CardTitle at 1.125rem.

body.purpose: 17px on html.site body; the product steps 1.05 / 0.95 / 0.9 / 0.85rem for descriptions, notes, hints and sub-lines.

label.purpose: t-tab, Label, ConsoleTag, PanelHeader, station meta, menu group labels.

condensed.purpose: Fare cells, slugs, addresses, shortcuts, chart ticks (12px), field--cond identifiers.

stamp.purpose: Every Badge and Stamp; the 0.75rem floor for text-[9px]/[10px]/[11px].

brand.purpose: The OnDesk plate (1.15rem) and the app's name (1.05rem) in the strip, the picker, the 404 and the board.

workspace-plate.purpose: The workspace name on its plate-block in the strip (0.95rem 800, tracking -0.01em).

rail.purpose: Page rail destinations and Tabs triggers, bold 0.95rem.

monogram.purpose: Two Condensed initials; Monogram 0.8 / 0.9 / 1.05rem, Avatar fallback 0.65 / 0.8 / 0.95rem uppercase.

extensions.elevation: Flat. product.css sets box-shadow: none on menu-paper, tip-paper, check-box, switch-track, sheet-paper, the Tailwind shadow-* utilities and the ring utility, and backdrop-filter: none on backdrop-blur-*. Depth is a 3px ink border or an ink/paper inversion. The only translucency is the scrim (rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.7)) under Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet and the native SheetDialog.

strokes.name: stroke
strokes.purpose: Every ring, tick, plate edge, ticket outline, field, panel, dialog, switch track, check, progress track, monogram, focus outline, table head/foot rule, zone-table joint and dialog header rule (--stroke).

strokes.name: line
strokes.purpose: The band (6 x 4px rows = 1.5rem, of which the six lines sum to the 10px idea at 4px each), the swatch, the stop mark, the chart share band, the spine (--line).

strokes.name: band-row
strokes.purpose: One row of the six-line band (LineBand .band-row).

strokes.name: rule-thin
strokes.purpose: Fare row borders, the rail row's rule, menu separators, dialog footers, the phone panel's rows, the chart grid.

strokes.name: perforation
strokes.purpose: The stub ticket's torn edge; 0.85rem in on the full ticket, 0.7rem on sm, 0.6rem on xs.

motion.name: clock
motion.purpose: --clock on :root and .site; every product duration divides it.

motion.name: band-dim
motion.purpose: A band row fading to 18% or back when the lit line changes (.band-row).

motion.name: menu-arrive
motion.purpose: menu-paper (DropdownMenu, Select, Popover, HoverCard, Command), menu-panel, sheet-paper (Dialog, AlertDialog) and the phone panel.

motion.name: scrim-in
motion.purpose: The 70% ink scrim fading in (0 to 1 opacity).

motion.name: slide-in
motion.purpose: A side sheet entering from its edge (translate 1.5rem, --slide-from) with opacity from 0.001.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Rail link colour, menu row tint, ticket background/colour/transform, field background, check fill, switch track and thumb (200ms).

motion.name: skeleton
motion.purpose: The loading skeleton never moves, in product.css and in both Skeleton components.

motion.name: chart
motion.purpose: Recharts lines draw without animation in the recomposed overview.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion removes band-row, switch, check and progress transitions and menu-paper, tip-paper, sheet-paper, slide-in and scrim animations.

easings.name: ease-arrive
easings.purpose: Entrances, fades, the band dim, the progress fill.

easings.name: ease-state
easings.purpose: Ticket, field, rail, menu row, check and switch state; the scrim.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: The app's name appears beside its swatch in the strip; the rail action appears; the workspace plate truncates at 14rem; dialog footers go to a row; the picker shows the person's name.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Fare headers wrap and fare--reflow recomposes rows into label/value blocks.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The search field and the action tickets appear, the menu button goes; the board goes to a row; zone cells pad 1.25rem; Display and Headline take their larger step.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The axis is drawn; the 'Apps' word and the account name appear in their tickets; lg:page-rail--stack stacks a section rail; overview splits 7/5; the workspace plate may reach 20rem.

layout.strip: header.strip sticky top 0 z 50 paper: .wrap row h-16 (brand: OnDesk plate, 1.6rem swatch + name from sm, workspace plate; nav: GlobalSearch field--sm field--search from md; actions from md: Apps, Nova, help, bell, account; menu button below md); LineBand (6 x 4px, one row lit, others 18%); .rail-row border-b 1px rule with .wrap holding nav.page-rail (flex-1, border removed) and railAction from sm. About 8.25rem tall. --stop-color: lineColor(app) on the strip and on the shell root.
layout.rail: page-rail: bold 0.95rem, 2.75rem tall, gap 1.75rem, ink-2 at rest, ink on hover/current, 3px bar in --stop-color under the current one (a[aria-current] or button[aria-selected=true]), sideways scroll without scrollbar. lg:page-rail--stack from 1024px: column, padding-left 1rem, items 0.75rem 0 on 1px rules, the bar on the left edge.
layout.axis: main.axis flex-1 min-height 40vh; ::before at left max(1.25rem, calc(50% - 44rem + 1.25rem)), 3px ink, from 1024px; .wrap pt-6 pb-24 around the Outlet.
layout.page: flex-col gap-10 (2.5rem) of stops; PageHeader first (rule, stop mark + meta, 1.25rem, title 1.5/1.625rem + description 1.05rem 72ch + actions); StatGrid zone table (gap 3px ink, cells p-4 md:p-5); fare fare--reflow lists; lg:grid-cols-12 gap-x-12 gap-y-10 with 7/5 for paired content; chart h-64 with its table under <details>.
layout.board: .board: .wrap py-10 flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-6 (paper OnDesk plate 1.15rem, swatch + app name 1.05rem, t-body tagline 0.95rem max-w-md; board-links 0.95rem gap-x-6 gap-y-2); border-top 3px white; .wrap py-4 0.9rem text-white/70 (copyright left, 'Northstar Platforms LLC' t-cond right).
layout.phone: Below 768px: a 3px-bordered menu button; the panel fixed inset-x-0 from top calc(4rem + 1.5rem) to bottom, z 50, paper, .wrap py-4, arrive, body scroll locked, closes on Escape and route change: MobileIdentity (monogram sm, bold name, t-cond 0.9rem email, border-b rule, pb-4), rows via mobileRowClass (border-b rule-2, py-3, bold, arrow), 'Change line' t-tab + MobileApps (swatch rows with taglines), PresenceChoices, full-width Sign out ticket.
layout.panels: menu-panel 20rem (w-80) mt-2, right-0 for Apps/Account, left-0 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] for the workspace switcher; menu-paper min 12rem, sideOffset 6 (tooltip 4); Popover w-72 (18rem) and HoverCard w-64 (16rem) with 1rem padding; Dialog min(32rem, 100% - 2rem) x max 100vh - 3rem, p-5, gap-4, header -mx-5 -mt-5 px-5 py-4 pr-14 on a 3px rule, footer rule-thin -mx-5 -mb-5 px-5 py-4 flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end; AlertDialog same at sm:max-w-lg or max-w-xs (20rem) for size=sm; Sheet w-3/4 sm:max-w-sm (24rem) from its side.
layout.shellLess: Workspace picker and root 404: own header (row h-16 without actions + LineBand focus on the app), main.axis .wrap (picker pt-10 md:pt-14 pb-24; 404 py-14 md:py-20), one stop with a plate H1 at 2.2/2.8rem and a t-body lead at 1.05rem; the picker's list is a fare fare--reflow in max-w-4xl and its footer is the rights line alone; the 404 has no board. In-workspace 404: a Headline-size stop in max-w-3xl.

variants.ghost: (outline ticket; the world has no shapeless button)

primitives.label: t-tab flex items-center gap-2
primitives.checkbox: check-box (1.25rem, fills ink; CheckIcon 3.5 stroke in paper)

card.root: flex flex-col gap-4 text-(--ink), no box
card.header: rule pt-4 grid with a CardAction column
card.title: t-h3 1.125rem

dialog.content: sheet-paper centred, max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] sm:max-w-lg, max-h-[calc(100vh-3rem)], p-5
dialog.title: t-h3 1.25rem

alert-dialog.content: sheet-paper, data-size sm max-w-xs / default sm:max-w-lg

command.input: 3px ink border-b, SearchIcon, h-12 bold, placeholder normal weight

primitives.sonner: theme light; --normal-bg paper, --normal-text ink, --normal-border ink, --border-radius 0; [data-sonner-toast] 3px ink, bold, no shadow

presence.pinnedOutline: PresenceDot ring={true} adds outline-2 outline-(--paper) to separate it from the face beneath.
presence.choices: PresenceChoices: radiogroup 'Your status', four rows (online, away, busy, invisible) as ring + bold word + 0.85rem description, chosen row bg paper-2, disabled 45%; consequence line 0.85rem aria-live below.

chart.rule: The app's own series in lineColor(app), the counterpart in ink, shares in the grey ramp [ink, #4d4d4d, #8a8a8a, #cfcfcf, #e6e6e6]; grid var(--rule) horizontal only; x-axis 1px ink; ticks Condensed 500 12px ink-2; lines 2px linear; dots r 4 paper-filled strokeWidth 2, active r 5; tooltip 3px ink on paper with a platform label and swatch rows; no animation; the same numbers as a fare table under <details>.

aliases.font-mono: Fira Sans Condensed via --font-mono in each app's index.css @theme
neutralised: shadow, shadow-xs, shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, shadow-2xl

fonts.source: Google Fonts link in each app's index.html (the six links are identical)

assets.geometry: Band, stub, swatch, stop mark, rings, check, switch, progress and zone joints are CSS in shared/styles/site.css and product.css or inline SVG in shared/components/map.tsx; the monogram is an uploaded logo or two Condensed initials in a 3px square.
assets.icons: Lucide stroke SVGs, functional only: menu, x, chevron-down, chevron-right, chevron-up, arrow-right, arrow-up-right, layout-grid, sparkles, search, check, copy, more-horizontal, plus, external-link, and the toaster's circle-check, info, triangle-alert, octagon-x, loader-2. StatTile, EmptyState and AlertDialogMedia accept an icon and paint nothing.
assets.reviewCaptures: Each app's .impeccable/review/*-desktop.png and *-mobile.png (pulse adds states/) were taken against synthetic fixtures by a puppeteer script in the session scratchpad; none of that data ships or is real.

components.name: Button as ticket (default, ghost, destructive, link, icon)
components.description: The shadcn Button rewritten: default is the solid stub ticket, outline and ghost are the outline ticket (no shapeless button), secondary sits on Platform Grey, destructive is red-stroked, link is an underlined word, icon is the square glyph ticket; default size 2.5rem, xs 2.25rem, lg 3.25rem.

components.name: Switch, check and progress
components.description: The three controls Radix paints itself, redrawn as 3px ink squares on paper: the switch's ink square crosses its track and the track inks when on; the check fills ink; the progress track fills with ink. State is position and inversion, never colour.

narrative.overview:
The six product apps are the Network Map seen from inside one of its lines. The public site draws six apps as six coloured transit lines on white paper; the signed-in console reads as a stack of ledger sheets; a product is where a member spends the day riding one of those lines, so its shell is the map's route strip with the app's own line lit in the six-line band and the other five dimmed to 18%, its destinations are the strip's second tier, and every screen is a sheet of stops whose marks are drawn in the app's colour. A member opening Pulse sees the OnDesk plate and the band before anything else, the same network as the site and the console; the red row at full colour says which line they are riding, the rail under it says where the line stops, and each page reads top to bottom as stops with every state printed as a word. Switching app is switching line: hovering another app in the Apps menu lights that line in the band before the jump.

The material is unchanged from the incumbent world (ondesk/DESIGN.md): paper and ink at daylight contrast, one 3px stroke for every ring, tick, plate edge, ticket outline, field and container, one 10px line for every transit line, swatch, stop segment and band, Fira Sans with its Condensed cut for labels and tables, tabular figures everywhere, one 12 s clock that every duration divides. The app's line colour appears only at line scale: the band, the swatch beside the app's name in the strip and the board, the stop marks, the rail's current bar, the primary series of a chart. It is never a text colour, never a background behind text and never a tint.

What a product adds is a way to be in the world without rewriting every screen. The world's CSS ships from @ondesk/shared/styles/ (site.css, a byte-identical copy of ondesk/src/site.css, and product.css, the product additions), each app mounts .site on <html> so Radix portals (dialogs, menus, tooltips, toasts) fall inside it, and the 24 shadcn primitives under @ondesk/shared/ui/ are rewritten once as map components with their shadcn API intact: a Button is a ticket, a Badge is a stamp, a Table is a fare table, Tabs are a page rail, a Card is a stop without a box, a Dialog is the paper dialog on the one scrim. A screen that has not been recomposed inherits the world through those primitives and through a short list of aliases and retirements in product.css (the old telemetry console-label becomes the platform label, font-mono resolves to Fira Sans Condensed in each app's index.css, sizes under 12px rise to the 0.75rem stamp floor, rounded-*, shadow-*, backdrop-blur-*, gradient-text, blink-cursor and scan-line paint nothing). It refuses the incumbent dark telemetry console (a sidebar over stat tiles, monospaced kickers with blinking cursors, lime accents, a theme toggle) and the category app shell (a left sidebar, an avatar circle, a card grid).
keyCharacteristics: White paper, black ink, the app's line colour only at line scale (band, swatch, stop mark, rail bar, chart series), never as text.
Inside an app one line is lit: the band dims the other five to 18% and the Apps menu previews a line on hover.
The strip has three tiers (row, band, rail); the rail carries the app's destinations and its one creating action as a small solid stub ticket.
Every page opens with a Stop (3px rule, the mark crossing the axis in the app's colour, the live datum as station meta, the 1.5rem title) and closes with a board.
Every shadcn primitive is a map component with its API kept: ticket, stamp, fare table, page rail, paper dialog, paper menu, ink tooltip, square check and switch.
Light only; .site on <html>; no theme toggle; the theme provider is a shim.
Square everywhere; round only the interchange ring and the presence ring.
Flat; the only translucency is the 70% ink scrim; depth is a 3px border or an inversion.
One clock (12 s); the band fades in clock/24, menus arrive in clock/24, tooltips in clock/40, state changes in clock/60.
States are words: a stamp, a status line, a ring beside its label; ticket status and priority read as ink words, not coloured pills.
Nothing prints below 0.75rem; nothing spins while loading except the toaster's own loading glyph (not canonized).

rules.name: The Lines Are Not Text Rule
rules.body: A line colour goes on stroke, background, a rect fill or a chart series, never on color. Inside a product this includes its own line: the app's name in the strip is ink beside a swatch, its stop marks are coloured segments beside ink titles, and its rail bar is a coloured 3px line under an ink word.

rules.name: The One Line Lit Rule
rules.body: The band inside an app has one row at full colour and five at 18% (band--focus, .band-row:not(.is-lit)), fading over clock/24; hovering or focusing an app in the Apps menu lights that row instead, and leaving the menu returns the band to the app's line. A product never shows the band fully lit except on a screen with no app context (there is none; the picker and the 404 light the app's line).

rules.name: The Chart Ramp Rule
rules.body: A chart draws the app's own series in its line colour, the counterpart in ink, and proportions as the grey ramp from ink to Rule Light; every chart is accompanied by the same numbers as a fare table. There is no second hue and no red-for-down, green-for-up: direction is a sentence ("Up 12% on the previous 30 days, the wrong way").

rules.name: The Words Not Colours Rule
rules.body: --warning, --success and --info are ink and Secondary Ink inside .site, so a status or priority badge from an older screen reads as an ink word in a stamp. Red is reserved for what stopped or is irreversible (stamp--alert, ticket--danger, StatTile tone="alert").

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Fira Sans and Fira Sans Condensed are the only families. --font-mono in each app's index.css @theme resolves to Fira Sans Condensed, so a screen still asking for font-mono prints platform-sign type, never monospace.

rules.name: The Stamp Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing inside .site prints below 0.75rem. product.css raises text-[9px], text-[10px] and text-[11px] to that floor; a new screen does not use them at all.

rules.name: The Word Rule
rules.body: Every state prints as a word: a stamp, a status line, a ring beside its label (PresenceRing prints its word or an sr-only word). The strip's account ticket shows the person's chosen status as a ring and hides the name below 1024px, but the ring keeps its title.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a title. PageHeader prints a tag only as station meta on the rule, only when it says something the title does not, and strips a leading ordinal ("01 — Overview" prints nothing); Card has no kicker slot; the old console-label renders as a platform label and belongs on the rule or beside a value, not over a heading.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth is a border or an inversion. A panel is 3px ink on paper; emphasis is ink and paper swapped; there is no third option.

rules.name: The One Stroke Rule
rules.body: --stroke (3px) is the only border weight: rings, ticks, plate edges, ticket outlines, fields, panels, dialogs, the switch track, the check, the progress track, the monogram, focus outlines, table head and foot rules, the zone table's joints and the dialog header's rule. The 1px Rule is the only thinner divider (fare rows, the rail row, menu separators, dialog footers, the strip's mobile rows); 2px is the underline of a link. --line (10px) is the only line weight: the band's six rows sum to it, the swatch, the stop mark, the share band, the spine.

rules.name: The Printed States Rule
rules.body: A control's state is printed, not lit. A ticket is an outline at rest and solid ink when primary; pressed, any ticket inverts (:active:not(:disabled)); disabled, it dims to 45% and keeps its shape; a solid ticket disabled because there is nothing to do yet prints as the dimmed outline (stub and aria-busy tickets keep their ink). A check is an empty 3px square that fills ink; a switch is an empty 3px track whose ink square crosses to the right and the track inks while the square turns paper; a progress bar is an empty 3px track filling with ink; a radio choice (a presence status, a DropdownMenuRadioItem) is a filled interchange ring; the chosen presence row is Platform Grey. Focus is the world's 3px ink outline offset 3px. Nothing glows, lifts or changes hue.

rules.name: The One Scrim Rule
rules.body: The 70% ink scrim appears only under a Dialog, an AlertDialog, a Sheet or the native SheetDialog. It is the one translucency in the world, and it is never used to dim a page for a menu.

dos: Do mount .site on <html> (<html lang="en" class="site">) and import @ondesk/shared/styles/site.css then product.css from src/index.css, with @source "../node_modules/@ondesk/shared"; set --font-sans to Fira Sans and --font-mono to Fira Sans Condensed in @theme, and every --radius-* to var(--radius) (0).

Do build the shell from ProductStrip with StripBrand + WorkspaceSwitch as brand, GlobalSearch as nav, AppsMenu · Nova · help · bell · AccountMenu as actions, the app's destinations as rail (Links with aria-current="page"), the one creating action as railAction (ticket ticket--xs ticket--solid ticket--stub, behind its permission), and MobileIdentity, the rows via mobileRowClass, "Change line" + MobileApps, PresenceChoices and a full-width Sign out as mobile; set --stop-color: lineColor(APP) on the shell root; wrap the Outlet in main.axis > .wrap.pt-6.pb-24; close with Board.
Do pass focus={preview ?? APP} to the strip and let AppsMenu's onPreview drive it, so hovering an app lights its line in the band.

Do open every page with PageHeader (the live datum in meta, the page's primary action in actions) and every errand below it with Section; put facts in StatGrid/StatTile with the change said in the hint, lists in .fare fare--reflow with data-label, cell-title and cell-actions, and a chart's numbers in a fare table under <details>.

Do use the shadcn primitives from @ondesk/shared/ui as they are: Button (default for the one primary act, outline/ghost for the rest, destructive for the irreversible, size="icon" for a glyph), Badge (default fact, secondary current, destructive stopped), Input/Textarea/Label/Select/Checkbox/Switch, Table, Tabs, Card, Dialog/AlertDialog/Sheet, DropdownMenu/Popover/HoverCard/Tooltip/Command, Avatar, Progress, Separator, Skeleton, Toaster; or the console-kit twins (Stamp, TextField, SaveRow, SheetDialog, ActionMenu, Monogram) in a hand-written screen.

Do draw a chart with the app's series in lineColor(APP), the counterpart in var(--ink), shares in the grey ramp (ink, #4d4d4d, #8a8a8a, #cfcfcf, #e6e6e6), grid in var(--rule), ticks in Condensed 12px Secondary Ink, dots paper-filled, no animation, and a 3px paper tooltip.
Do print presence with PresenceRing (or PresenceDot + STATUS_META.dot) and its word, and show the person's own choice in the account ticket.
Do write every duration as calc(var(--clock) / n); entrances and fades use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), state uses ease-out.

Do keep shared/styles/site.css byte-identical to ondesk/src/site.css and put every product-only rule in product.css; keep the six workspace-shell.tsx files one template that differs only in APP, destinations, rail action, links and tagline.
Do reserve the message line under a field (FieldShell), print a stop with nothing in it as an EmptyState sentence, and say a good or bad figure in words.

Do keep a screen not yet recomposed compiling and inheriting: it may still say console-label, font-mono, text-[10px], rounded-lg or shadow-sm, and the aliases will print the world; recompose it by replacing those with PageHeader, Section, StatGrid, .fare, tickets and stamps.
donts: Don't add a dark mode, a .dark variant, a theme toggle or an Appearance setting; ThemeProvider is a shim and useTheme always answers "light".
Don't typeset anything in the app's line colour or any line colour, and don't tint a background with one; the line lives in the band, the swatch, the stop mark, the rail bar and a chart series.
Don't colour a status or priority (green resolved, amber pending, blue open, red urgent); a state is a word in a stamp, and only what stopped or cannot be undone is red.

Don't put a sidebar over stat tiles, a card grid, an avatar circle or a mono kicker with a blinking cursor back; the strip's rail is the navigation, the zone table is the facts, the monogram is square, the platform label is the caption.
Don't use a shapeless button: a glyph alone goes in Button size="icon" (the square outline ticket); ticket--ghost is for a glyph inside a row and nothing else.
Don't print anything below 0.75rem, and don't add text-[9px], text-[10px] or text-[11px] to a new screen even though the floor would catch them.
Don't add a radius, a shadow, a blur, a gradient or a lift; rounded-*, shadow-* and backdrop-blur-* are neutralised in .site and belong to no new screen.
Don't use Tailwind's ring utility for focus; the world's focus is the 3px ink outline and .ring is the interchange ring.
Don't hardcode a millisecond duration or a Tailwind duration-*, transition-colors or transition-transform; a transition that is not a fraction of --clock is off the timetable.
Don't light the whole band inside an app, and don't leave another app's line lit after the Apps menu closes.
Don't add a seventh hue, a coloured arrow for up or down, or an animated chart; direction is a sentence and the numbers are a table.
Don't split a URL, slug or e-mail with break-all; use Breakable or overflow-wrap: anywhere.
Don't spin anything while loading; the skeleton is still and a pending ticket says "Saving…".
Don't edit shared/styles/site.css for a product need or copy product.css into an app; the world is one file and the product additions are the other.

notCanonized: Pulse's StatusBadge and PriorityBadge (pulse/src/shared/components/) still use text-[9px]/text-[10px] (caught by the floor), a rounded-full dot (rendered as a 6px ink square), font-mono text-xs in the indicator variant, and bg-info/8, bg-warning/8, bg-primary/8, /30 and /25 alpha borders of ink, which print faint second tints; they read as ink words but are not the stamp and should be recomposed to Badge tones.

Screens not recomposed in the six apps keep the old devices behind the aliases: in pulse/src/features alone 27 files use rounded-*, 62 text-muted-foreground, 29 border-border/bg-card; across the six 95 files still say console-label and 204 font-mono. They inherit the world and are work to do, not system.

Tailwind's 150ms transition-colors / transition-transform on the strip's menu button, the chevrons (rotate-180 on open), the arrows in tickets and links (group-hover:translate-x-1), the presence rows and StripLink run off the clock, as in the incumbent.

product.css declares .site .strip .page-rail { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule) } and later { border-bottom: 0 }; the later wins and ProductStrip also sets borderBottom: 0 inline; the first rule is dead. The rule lives on .rail-row.

--chart-1 is ink and --chart-2 the app's line (product.css), while the recomposed overview draws the app's series (Opened, var(--l-pulse)) first and Resolved in ink; two orderings of the same two colours.
Avatar (1.5 / 2 / 2.5rem) and Monogram (2.25 / 2.75 / 3.5rem) are two monogram scales; AvatarBadge's 2px paper border, AvatarGroup's and PresenceDot ring's 2px paper outlines are off the 3px stroke.
shared/ui Textarea carries min-h-16 (4rem) where the console-kit TextArea lets rows measure it.
The root 404 (pulse/src/components/not-found.tsx) prints the requested path with break-all, which the incumbent's Don't forbids.
The toaster's loading glyph spins (animate-spin) and is exempted from the rounded-full reset; the world otherwise spins nothing.
Board link white (rgba(255,255,255,0.8), #fff current) and rights line (text-white/70) sit beside the world's Board Muted (0.72): three whites.
--info is var(--ink-2) while --warning and --success are var(--ink), so an 'open' status word from an old badge prints one step lighter than 'pending' or 'resolved'.
pulse/src/index.css keeps --pulse-ink, --pulse-ink-deep and --pulse-lime (remapped to #ffffff) for screens that still read them.

On 2026-09-30 partners/src/site.css and developers/src/site.css (identical to each other, md5 56d71702…) and admin/src/site.css (md5 d3f89c96…) each differ from ondesk/src/site.css (md5 aa12f9a6…); only shared/styles/site.css matches it, so the incumbent's 'identical copies in the four consoles' is not currently true.

shared/ui holds 24 primitives (alert-dialog, avatar, badge, button, card, checkbox, command, dialog, dropdown-menu, hover-card, input, label, popover, progress, select, separator, sheet, skeleton, sonner, switch, table, tabs, textarea, tooltip), not the 25 the brief named.

The 2.2rem → 2.8rem plate H1 of the picker and the 404 is the console's gate-state size and, like the console's steps, a literal Tailwind size rather than a named utility; recorded as the products' Display, not as drift.
